title: Godzilla Minus Zero Rotten Tomatoes score? Above 94
rules: If Godzilla Minus Zero has a Tomatometer score of above 94 on Nov 9, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: The film sits at 96% from 46 reviews and has held at 95-96% since its festival premiere, but YES needs it to still show 95% or higher after roughly 150-200 reviews. Reviews that arrive around wide release often pull scores down 1-3 points, and a few mixed or negative notices (Empire 3/5, Dread Central) are already in. Minus One kept a 97-99% score, so holding 95% is plausible, which makes this close to a coin flip.
blind.falsifier: Six or more extra rotten reviews around the Nov 6 US release, pushing the Tomatometer down to 94% or lower by Nov 9.

final.reasoning: The market's 69.5% suggests more confidence than my estimate, possibly from newer score data, so I move up partway to 58%. YES needs at least a 95.5% fresh rate across a large final review count, which leaves little room for the usual post-release drift, so NO still looks underpriced.
